purpose: Trace each controllable-flux scheme to reproducible simulation, architecture verification, or the next numeric model required. Passing tests prove the coverage record is complete, not that every scheme has reached final engineering validation.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-001 sweeps negative id operating points under voltage/current constraints and identifies the 100 Nm reachable boundary.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Add temperature-dependent id_min(T) demagnetization feasibility to the search candidate filter.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-001 includes minimum-current target torque points and max-feasible-torque MTPV-style points across speed. Control LUT generator now exports id/iq trajectories with mode labels and feasibility information.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Add temperature-dependent id_min(T) demagnetization feasibility, Vdc variation sweeps, and closed-loop mode transition continuity validation to the control LUT.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-005 sweeps an explicit k_mod axis and applies parametric harmonic / inverter-loss / torque-ripple penalties on top of the linear dq grid search.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Replace parametric harmonic / loss curves with measured inverter loss maps and PWM-reconstructed THD.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-006 now covers both synthetic lambda_d/lambda_q LUT validation and constrained speed-sweep search integration, proving the LUT participates in current/voltage-limited candidate selection while EXP-001 remains the linear baseline.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Connect the nonlinear flux LUT to run_control_lut_generator.py for MTPA/FW/MTPV control trajectory export, then extend the same model into iron-loss, thermal, and demagnetization boundary workflows.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-003 scales Ld/Lq/saliency and ranks candidates as a clean-room proxy before real FEA.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Replace scaled Ld/Lq proxy with FEA-derived lambda_d/lambda_q candidate maps.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-003 covers lower psi_f and higher saliency variants that approximate PMaSynRM design directions.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Add PM fraction and torque ripple screening fields instead of only psi/Ld/Lq scaling.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-002 sweeps virtual psi_f states for high/mid/low flux comparison.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Add state transition energy, state confidence, and unknown-state derating to the variable flux experiment.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-007 implements the equivalent psi_eff = psi_pm + kf * if model and compares boundary copper-loss + steady-state field copper loss.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Add field-winding inductance, exciter loss, and rotor leakage; couple thermally to the field circuit.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-008 sweeps configurations whose Ke/L/Rs/Imax are scaled from turns_scale and runs a transition continuity check at the configured switching speed.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Model contactor switching transients, circulating currents, and parallel-path thermal sharing.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-009 derates available phase current per case (balanced / imbalanced / one_group_lost / limp_home) and reports max reachable speed at target torque.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Add harmonic subspace decoupling, neutral-shift voltage vectors, and per-phase thermal RC for fault transients.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-004 applies Rs(T), psi_f(T), Vdc derating, and simplified id_min(T) demag limits to target-torque reachability.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Replace simplified demag line with FEA or magnet datasheet-derived id_min(T, fault) tables.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-010 scores candidates against drive cycles using weighted copper loss. EXP-011 extends to combined copper+iron loss using Bertotti three-term model, improving efficiency estimates at high speed.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Replace iron loss coefficients with FEA-derived material data; add mechanical loss, inverter loss, and temperature coupling to the combined loss model.
